title: Number fields as curves over $\mathbf{F}_1$
summary: We study function fields in one variable over the field with one element $\mathbf{F}_1$. It is proved that the Galois extensions of $\mathbf{Q}$ are isomorphic to the curves over $\mathbf{F}_1$ being understood as the Deitmar schemes. Specifically, one gets explicit formulas linking the genus and the number of cusps of an algebraic curve over the extension $\mathbf{F}_{1^m}$ of order $m\ge 1$ of the field $\mathbf{F}_1$ and the $m$-th roots of unity of the corresponding number field.
